slot.brief: Series LCR at resonance: express Q in terms of R, L, C and compute it, then relate to sharpness/bandwidth symbolically.

stem: For a series LCR circuit, the resonant frequency is $f_0 = \dfrac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}$ and the quality factor is $Q = \dfrac{1}{R}\sqrt{\dfrac{L}{C}}$. The bandwidth $\Delta f$ of the resonance curve is:
working: Angular bandwidth $\Delta\omega = \dfrac{\omega_0}{Q} = \dfrac{2\pi f_0}{Q} = \dfrac{2\pi\left(\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}\right)}{\frac{1}{R}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}}} = \dfrac{R}{L}$. Then $\Delta f = \dfrac{\Delta\omega}{2\pi} = \dfrac{R}{2\pi L}$.
solution:
For a series LCR circuit, $Delta\omega=\omega_0/Q$. Hence
$$\Delta f=\frac{\Delta\omega}{2\pi}=\frac{f_0}{Q}=\frac{\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}}{\frac{1}{R}\sqrt{L/C}}=\frac{R}{2\pi L}.$$
